verdict.rationale: Conductor is a Mac app built to run many coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) in parallel. Each task gets its own workspace, branch, terminal, diff and review path, all organized in one sidebar with sections and a Home view of everyone's work. Community users corroborate the parallel worktree UI, and the parallel-session docs are explicit. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of managing many sessions at scale from the unified view (community feedback is mostly early impressions).

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can manage multiple agent-driven coding sessions from one unified workspace
